waypoints.name: Shannon Ridge TH
waypoints.note: End of FR 1152-014 spur off Baker Lake Road.
waypoints.directions: From SR 20 at milepost 82 near Concrete, turn north on Baker Lake Road (FS Road 11) and drive about 24 miles to FS Road 1152, directly across from Shannon Creek Campground. Turn left on 1152, then take a sharp right onto spur 1152-014 and follow it to the road end at about 2,500 ft. The gravel can be potholed but is passable to most cars. A Northwest Forest Pass or equivalent recreation pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Sulphide Glacier camp
waypoints.note: The usual camp on the flat plateau at the edge of the Sulphide Glacier, above the 5,400 ft pass where the glacier first comes into view.
waypoints.directions: Climb the Shannon Ridge trail east-northeast up the ridge to the 5,400 ft pass where the Sulphide Glacier first comes into view, then continue up the open snow to the large flat plateau at about 6,400 ft at the edge of the glacier. The featureless snow between 5,400 and 6,400 ft is hard to navigate in poor visibility.

waypoints.name: Notch below SE Ridge
waypoints.note: Trend right off the Sulphide Glacier onto the ridge; ~600 vertical ft of 5.3-5.7 to the summit.
